#### Quick Answers About Our Work

## Frequently Asked Questions

- ###### Do you handle both commercial and residential plumbing?

































Yes. Coastal Plumbing Mechanical Service works with businesses, HOAs, property managers, and individual homeowners. From multi-unit buildings to single-family homes, our licensed plumbers handle projects of every size.

- ###### What areas do you serve in South Florida?

































We cover Broward, Miami-Dade, and Palm Beach counties, with occasional work in Key West and other parts of Florida’s east coast. Whether you’re in Fort Lauderdale, Miami, or West Palm Beach, our team is nearby and ready to help.

- ###### Are you available for emergency plumbing calls?

































Absolutely. We offer 24/7 emergency plumbing services across South Florida. Burst pipes, severe leaks, or major backups can happen anytime, and our team is on call to respond quickly.
